data.text: Luke, keeping the total at 50 makes sense, but I don’t see why you and John should start with more while the rest of us take less. My family has fished here for generations; I want this lake to keep supporting all our families. I propose 10 tons each this month—a fair $10,000 apiece, with the lake back to 100 next month if everyone sticks to it. We can review the revealed catches together afterward. Kate, would you support that?
